items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a morphism of sites given by a continuous functor sends points of the target to points of the source by composition, and that the stalk of a pullback at the given point is the stalk at the induced point (statement lines 8774-8791). The proof is a complete argument: the elementary conditions for the composite functor follow immediately (proof lines 8794-8796); the identification of the stalks is a chain of equalities using the companion results (proof lines 8797-8804); and the exactness condition holds because the composite is a composite of exact functors (proof lines 8805-8807). The non-formal content is the chain of identifications. The claim is H1: three short steps, each written out.
